programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Alex's Feathery Friends; Pups Save a Puffy Mayor
programs.desc: The "PAW Patrol" must rescue Mr. Porter and reunite an ostrich family before the big birds get into trouble; During Mayor Goodway's fashion show, the pups must save Farmer Al and Mayor Humdinger after Humdinger's puffy shirt floats away with them.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Wheels: Pups Save Adventure Bay
programs.desc: Two competitive truckers come to town for a monster truck rally, one of them befriends the pups, the other stirs up lots of trouble.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups and Cats Save HumCatDingerMan; Pups Save a Turbot Tournament
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger becomes HumCatDingerMan to steal the spotlight from Cat Pack; the pups must save Tilly during the Turbot Tournament.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Ace's Birthday Surprise; Pups Save a Tower of Pizza
programs.desc: Rocky and the pups fix an old junk car for Ace Sorensen's birthday; Adventure Bay works hard to earn the record for having the world's highest tower of pizzas.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Take in a Runaway Kitty!; Pups Save the Cheese Goat!
programs.desc: When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: The key to reassembling the Paradox Prism lies in one of the Shatterspaces; Nine and Sonic seek a portal to safely transport the Shards there.
